actual_scope: Prove that Schur fill on a linear window keeps boundary rank separation within the published half-bandwidth of 2w.
scope_change_reason: The q-factorization is a different question. This package checks the boundary bandwidth. It does not run the Gaussian core.
bottleneck_link: Every checked filled boundary pair stays inside the published half-bandwidth, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Record this bandwidth. Do not run the Gaussian core.
evidence: On all 196605 compositions with width 1 to 3 and length at most 16, boundary rank separation is at most 2w-1. A single long piece attains 2w-1 for every width from 1 through 40.
